title: Breakfasts and garden jam sessions around Kansas City
summary: Boots takes him to private-home breakfasts with Lips and garden sessions where he played brushes on cardboard beside Mary Lou Williams.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: But she took me to all these wonderful things -- to breakfasts from seven to ten o'clock in the morning with hot biscuits and all that, with Lips.
What town are you in now?
Yeah, the place where the black people ate, the restaurant there.
I never went to that restaurant.

Just a private home. And at sunset, there was a little place we'd play in the garden, and MaryLou used to come and play and I used to carry a pair of brushes with me and play a piece of cardboard. So I wasn't thrown out, nobody said no. So that's how I progressed, but I listened to that -- I heard things in Kansas City, and everybody that was
there says the same thing. There aren't enough superlatives to tell you how intense the music was.
